capabilities: create nested folder and file structures for daily notes in one click
name generated folders and files with moment.js format patterns
apply markdown templates to generated files and folder notes
group a week's daily notes using custom month-of-week tokens
extras: Docs warn that some invalid format patterns fail silently; evaluation errors only appear in the developer console.
problem: Obsidian's daily notes workflow produces single files in one folder, so users who organize each day into multiple folders and files must create them by hand.

relations.evidence: Folder Notes by Lost Paul Use this to display default notes when clicking on folders.

summary: One-click generator that creates a nested folder and file structure for each daily note, using moment.js name patterns and optional templates.
